kind: reviewable task-only bounded audio capture proposal
preferred_method: parec --monitor-stream=1664 connected to the exact sink248 monitor. PulseAudio supports selecting only the specified sink input from its sink monitor; do not capture the undifferentiated speaker monitor. This avoids changing game routing or output. PipeWire1.6.8 compatibility requires a bounded real capture check before acceptance.
required_guards: Revalidate actual host process74708 birth6014333 and exact stream1664 application.process.id74708/object.serial1664/client1656/sink248 immediately before starting. Abort on mismatch or missing process.
Use8s maximum capture with own recorder process handle and bounded INT/KILL cleanup; stop immediately if stream or process identity disappears/changes. Never signal the game or unrelated processes.
Require exact per-stream monitor target. If unsupported, failed, disappeared or silently rebound, reject file/abort; never drop --monitor-stream or record the shared speaker mix.
Do not enable microphones, alter default devices, change volumes/mute/routing, inject audio, use arbitrary media or print unrelated media metadata.
For coverage of both game streams, capture each exact owned stream to separate bounded files with identity guards; retain separate provenance, do not assume the corked stream is always silent.

Record root-selected native gameplay action/timestamps and build/seed. Audio sample energy supports capture/liveness only; perceptual sound correctness still needs actual listening and expected-action comparison.

Do not change defaults or move unrelated audio. Pin created module ID/unique sink name.
Restore a surviving game stream only if its exact identity still matches and it remains on the task sink; preserve intervening user routing changes.
Unload only the captured module ID after task streams are restored and sink is empty. Report any restoration failure precisely.
This inventory task has NOT loaded modules, moved streams, created sinks or recorded audio.
